text:
1. 3. 1. 7

Sotāpanta suttaṃ

109. Sāvatthiyaṃ:

Pañcime bhikkhave, upādānakkhandhā, katame pañca, seyyathidaṃ: rūpupādānakkhandho vedanupādānakkhandho saññupādānakkhandho saṃkhārūpādānakkhandho viññāṇapādānakkhandho

Yato kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvako imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upadānakkhandhānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañaca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti. Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, ariyasāvako sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇoti.
